title: Clique partitions of chordal graphs: quantitative stability and sharp eventual bounds
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the chordal results of the author's preprint "Clique partitions with rooted simplicial defect: quantitative stability and sharp eventual bounds" (Erdős #81 series, Paper IV). With M(n) = ⌊n(n+1)/6⌋: there is b such that every chordal graph on n vertices has a clique partition into pieces of order at most four with at most M(n) + b pieces (Theorem A); for n large every chordal graph on n vertices has one with at most M(n) pieces, and some chordal graph on n vertices has one with exactly M(n) pieces that is optimal among all clique partitions (Theorem B, the bound asked in Erdős Problem #81 and its sharpness); 1/6 is the least quadratic coefficient (§6.3); the uniform mixed rounding of fractional triangle/K₄ packings (Theorem 3.1); integral stability with explicit constants and edit distance at most 16δ to a complete-split graph, for 0 ≤ δ ≤ γn² with γ = 10⁻¹⁶/4 (Theorem 6.1); same-root control of near-optimal partitions: one clique root satisfies all the conclusions of Theorem 6.1 and, for it, every partition with at most M(n) + τ pieces has at most τ + 48δ noncanonical pieces (Corollary 6.1a); the root-defect identity (6.7b); and the eventual classification of the extremal chordal graphs as complete-split graphs with a core of optimal size (Corollary 6.2). Version 2 adds the fixed-defect results for graphs of rooted simplicial defect at most s: the sharp eventual bound Q_s(n) = M(n + s) − C(s + 1, 2), attained by a partition optimal among all clique partitions (Theorem C); same-root stability with A_s = 2·10⁴¹·(s + 1)⁸ for 0 ≤ δ ≤ γn², edit distance at most A_s δ, at most τ + (1 + 7A_s)δ noncanonical pieces carrying at most 10τ + 10(1 + 7A_s)δ edges (Theorem C′); comparison with an optimal-size template at distance at most A_s δ + n√((1 + 4A_s)δ) and the equality case cp = c₄ = Q_s(n) (Corollary 6.3); the necessity of the square-root term (Proposition 6.3a); the bounds F₄(G) ≤ M(n − s) + ns (minus C(s + 1, 2) when 4s ≤ n) and their integral form up to εn² (Proposition 6.4); the sublinear-defect bound n²/6 + o(n²) and root stability (Theorem 6.5); the bound Q_s(n) for all s ≤ S once n ≥ T(P(S)), an explicit tower (Corollary 6.6); and the annex inequality: a chordal K_{d+2}-free graph has fractional triangle packing number at most ν₃ + (10 + d/2)n (G.1). 21 statements. The thresholds N and γ in Theorems B, C, C′ and Corollary 6.3 are existential; b, N, A_s and the tower are not claimed optimal.
